title: Jhoola hai ya taboot tumhara ali asghar
body:
Jhoola hai ya taboot tumhara ali asghar
Madar ke labo'n par hai..
Madar ke labo'n par hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh nauha ali asghar
<<MINI>>
Jhoola hai ya taboot tumhara ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Pehlu mein mere aaj se soegi sakina..(2)
tum baap ki aghosh mein sona ali asghar
2. Sar saare shahido ke uthe naizo pe lekin..(2)
uttha tera naize pe janaza ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Us waqt sakina bhi khadi dekh rahi thi..(2)
Naizo'n ne jo dhundha tera
Naizo'n ne jo dhundha tera laasha ali asghar
4. Is tarha se rukhsaar tere khoon mein tarr the..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
maa dekh na paayi tera chehra ali asghar
5. Mohsin ka unhe dijiyo pursa mere beta..(2)
jab goad mein legi tujhe..(2) Zahra ali asghar
6. Layi hu teri qabr se Maula ko utha kar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
uthte hi nahi the shahe wala ali asghar
7. Akbar na sula payenge tum zidd nahi karna..(2)
seene ka abhi zakhm hai..(2) taaza ali asghar
8. Maa boli takallum mujhe mare gaye patthar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne diya yu tera..(2) pursa ali asghar
